title: Xenobiology
description: Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.

puzzle.goal: An alien genome is a string of L letters drawn from an alphabet of b chemically distinct bases, base j appearing with probability p_j. Write the information it can store, in bits: the length times the average surprise per letter, built from the probabilities and their logarithms, converted from natural units to bits.
puzzle.name: Shannon entropy of a genome sequence
puzzle.form: - L * sum ( j , 1 , b , p _ j * ln ( p _ j ) / ln ( 2 ) )
puzzle.ask: For equally likely bases p_j = 1/b this becomes L·log₂ b. Find the information in bits of a @{L}-letter genome over an 8-letter alphabet.
puzzle.method: Average −log₂ p_j over the alphabet; log₂ p = ln p / ln 2; multiply by the number of letters.
